ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, SUPPRESS through the context functions since #51 (assumed): splitByValue keeps SUPPRESS as a slot with its bit, in every mode; the SUPPRESS comes from createIf, true for 1 or true in any case and SUPPRESS for anything else (fn/createIf/002); ADR-0006 TargetSlots: a SUPPRESS slot creates nothing; observation #61
note: fn/splitByValue/019 without collapseContexts, so SUPPRESS shows: Tag in context Orders is true, false | true, false, false, one Item per Tag, five. createIf gives "", SUPPRESS, "", SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS, and eachValue puts each slot in a context of its own: [""] [SUPPRESS] [""] [SUPPRESS] [SUPPRESS]. Item i reads context i, so Items 1 and 3 get an empty V and Items 2, 4 and 5 none. SUPPRESS taken for "" gives a V in every Item; dropping SUPPRESS gives two contexts, a V in Items 1 and 2.
